symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1400: describe emits `content { }` for native pluggable-widget child slots (Repeater, SafeAreaView); check fails "`content` is not a container of `repeater` — it declares: template [MDL-WIDGET26]" and exec fails "content needs a name". 35 occurrences in the round-trip runs.
cause: Two derivations of one keyword. The widget definition names a widgets-typed slot with mdlContainerForWidgetSlot (content -> TEMPLATE, plus per-widget overrides); describe's extractChildSlots borrowed deriveObjectListKeyword, the OBJECT-LIST convention (singularise, its own override table), which leaves `content` as is.
fix: extractChildSlots derives the keyword with mdlContainerForWidgetSlot(widgetID, key), the function the definition side uses.
insight: **When describe and the definition each compute a keyword, they must call the same function** — describe borrowed the nearest-looking helper (object lists) and agreed with the definition on every key except the overridden ones, so only a widget with a `content` slot showed it. The MDL-WIDGET26 message lists what the definition declares; compare that against the describe output before reading either side's code. Not covered: a placeholder inside a SafeAreaView is invisible to layoutPlaceholderNames (mdl/backend/modelsdk/layout_write.go), which walks only typed containers, not a CustomWidget's raw child slots.
